title: On the Faithfulness of Visual Thinking: Measurement and Enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2510.23482v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent large vision-language models (LVLMs) can generate vision-text multimodal chain-of-thought (MCoT) traces after reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT). However, we observe that the visual information in MCoT is often inaccurate even when answers are correct, and task accuracy remains nearly unchanged despite the visual information being corrupted. This indicates a lack of faithfulness in the vision part of MCoT reasoning. We attribute this to the RL reward design in RFT, which solely incentivizes the format of interleaved vision-text cues, encouraging the model to incorporate visual information into its text reasoning steps without considering its correctness. In this paper, we first probe MCoT faithfulness by measuring how much the prediction changes when its visual and textual thoughts are intervened. translated_title: 论视觉思考的忠实性：测量与增强
translated_abstract: 近期的大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在经过强化微调（RFT）后能够生成视觉-文本多模态思维链（MCoT）推理轨迹。然而，我们观察到，即使答案正确，MCoT中的视觉信息也常常是不准确的，而且即使视觉信息被破坏，任务准确率也几乎保持不变。这表明MCoT推理中视觉部分缺乏忠实性。我们将此归因于RFT中的强化学习奖励设计，该设计仅仅激励视觉-文本交错线索的格式，鼓励模型将视觉信息纳入其文本推理步骤中，却不考虑其正确性。在本文中，我们首先通过测量当视觉思考和文本思考受到干预时模型预测的变化程度，来探究MCoT的忠实性。令人惊讶的是，在视觉干预下模型的预测几乎保持不变，而在文本干预下却发生显著变化。
tldr: 该论文揭示了经过强化微调的LVLMs在多模态思维链推理中视觉信息缺乏忠实性（破坏视觉内容几乎不影响预测结果），将其归因于RFT奖励设计只激励交错格式而忽视视觉信息正确性，并提出了测量与增强视觉思考忠实性的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that visual information in the multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning of RL-finetuned LVLMs lacks faithfulness—corrupting visual content barely changes predictions—attributing this to RFT reward designs that incentivize only interleaved formatting rather than visual correctness, and proposes methods to measure and enhance the faithfulness of visual thinking.
